mapper.update: update member_order_info set status=#{status} where order_id in (${orderIds}) and deleted = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT `key`,create_time, ifnull( SUM( price ), 0 ) `value` FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%m-%d' ) `key`,create_time, ifnull( sum( group_pay_price ), 0 ) `price` FROM member_group_pay_info WHERE deleted = 0
and to_days(create_time) >= to_days(#{startTime}) and to_days(create_time) <= to_days(#{endTime})
and store_id=#{storeId}
and store_id in (select store_id from member_store_user where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} AND type IN (12,13))
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%m-%d' ) UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%m-%d' ) `key`,create_time, ifnull( sum( price / 100.0 ), 0 ) `price` FROM member_pay_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND pay_status = 1 AND refund_price = 0
and to_days(create_time) >= to_days(#{startTime}) and to_days(create_time) <= to_days(#{endTime})
and store_id=#{storeId}
and store_id in (select store_id from member_store_user where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} AND type IN (12,13))
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT( create_time, '%m-%d' ) ) t GROUP BY `key` ORDER BY create_time asc

select d.label as `key`,count(1) `value` from member_order_info o left join system_dict_data d on d.value=o.pay_type and d.dict_type='member_order_pay_type' where o.deleted = 0 and o.status in (0, 1, 2)
and to_days(o.create_time) >= to_days(#{startTime}) and to_days(o.create_time) <= to_days(#{endTime})
and o.store_id=#{storeId}
and o.store_id in (select store_id from member_store_user where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} AND type IN (12,13))
group by o.pay_type

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') `key`,count(distinct user_id) `value` from member_order_info where deleted = 0 and status in (0, 1, 2)
and to_days(create_time) >= to_days(#{startTime}) and to_days(create_time) <= to_days(#{endTime})
and store_id=#{storeId}
and store_id in (select store_id from member_store_user where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} AND type IN (12,13))
group by DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') order by create_time asc

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') `key`,count(distinct room_id) `value` from member_order_info where deleted = 0 and status in (1, 2)
and to_days(create_time) >= to_days(#{startTime}) and to_days(create_time) <= to_days(#{endTime})
and store_id=#{storeId}
and store_id in (select store_id from member_store_user where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} AND type IN (12,13))
group by DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%m-%d') order by create_time asc

select DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') `key`,sum(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,start_time,end_time))/60.0 `value` from member_order_info where deleted = 0 and status in ( 1, 2)
and to_days(create_time) >= to_days(#{startTime}) and to_days(create_time) <= to_days(#{endTime})
and store_id=#{storeId}
and store_id in (select store_id from member_store_user where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} AND type IN (12,13))
group by DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by create_time asc
select order_id, order_no, store_id, room_id, user_id, start_time, end_time, status from member_order_info o where o.deleted = 0 and o.status = #{status}
select count(1) from member_order_info where deleted = 0 and room_id = #{roomId} and status = 0 and start_time > now()

select count(1) from member_order_info where deleted = 0 and room_id = #{roomId} and status in (0, 1) and start_time>now()
and order_id!=#{ignoreOrderId}
select * from member_order_info where deleted = 0 and order_no = #{orderNo}
select * from member_order_info where deleted = 0 and status = 1 and room_id = #{roomId} and start_time <= now() and end_time > now() limit 1
